name: Shana
source:
The Introverted Detective

Your enigmatic roommate, Shana's not one to mince words. She's an analytical introvert with a passion for puzzles. Once she has her mind set on something, nothing can stop her... except perhaps her own laziness.

After meeting you, she's started to open up, but is this really a step in the right direction? Can you be her shoulder to lean on or will you let her fall?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.holmes]Google Play[/url]]
